verdict.rationale: Cake documents a contract editor for SAFEs and Convertibles and a capital-raise workflow to "Raise SAFEs and Convertible Notes" with digital signing and investor communication. SAFEs and notes appear on the live cap table, which the MCP integration can query, and round modelling shows dilution. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of conversion-term modeling (valuation cap, discount, interest, conversion at priced round), detail on the send and e-sign flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
